name: Sure Jersey Data Centre
notes: A-grade facility existence and 500 kW (0.5 MW) IT load per Sure official Jersey Data Centre page/specification sheet: Tier III colocation, 24h security, data halls/cages, inter-island connectivity. Address per directory: Queen's Road, St Helier (0.5 MW; slug references The Powerhouse/Foreshore) - address grade C until cross-checked with operator/JCRA/gov.je. JT 'First Tower Lane' (Guernsey/St Peter Port) is excluded as non-JE; no hyperscale cloud region (AWS/Azure/GCP/OCI) lists Jersey - official region pages used for exclusion.
